mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined in the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in the unemployment rate (increase > 0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by >0.5pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales (both falling below their prior-month levels) indicates a severe contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS declined from the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production exceeding 1.0% over the prior 3 months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO fell by >1.0% over 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declined in the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in unemployment rate (both occurring in the prior month) indicates a broad economic contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declined and UNRATE rose in the prior month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 1.0%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
